stem:
Ira winds insulated copper wire around an iron nail and joins the coil to a cell to make an electromagnet. She brings the north pole of a magnetic compass near end A of the nail. The compass needle is attracted towards A. End B is the other end of the nail.

Which claim about the poles is correct?

options.text: End A is a South pole and end B is a North pole.
End A is a North pole and end B is a South pole.
Both ends A and B are South poles.
Both ends A and B are North poles.

teacher.key_rationale: Unlike poles attract, so the compass north pole attracted to A means A is South and B is North. B reverses the poles; C and D treat both ends as the same pole.
